blurb: Guests can visit the brewery to enjoy the freshest Dominion City beer and purchase cans to-go at the Corner Store. The Corner Store also offers a curated selection of bottles and cans from independent Ontario producers, which must be purchased with food. The taproom is open for on-site beer tasting and socializing.
extraNote: Returns accepted within 30 days if item is unopened and in original packaging; perishable goods like beer or food cannot be returned unless quality issue · Beer deliveries require recipient to be 19 or older; delivery attempts will be made and beer returned to brewery if recipient not available · Dominion City Brewing Co. at 15-5510 Canotek Rd, Ottawa, ON K1J 9J4
